hooks.prompt: The assistant is about to run a bash command. If the command contains 'bench drop-site', 'bench destroy-all-sessions', 'bench reinstall', 'rm -rf', or 'bench --force', respond 'no' to block the command as it is destructive. Otherwise respond 'yes'.

hooks.command: if [ -f sites/common_site_config.json ]; then SITES=$(ls sites/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'common_site_config\|apps.txt\|assets' | tr '\n' ', '); CURRENT=$(cat sites/currentsite.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 'none'); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"additionalContext\":\"Frappe bench detected. Current site: $CURRENT. Available sites: $SITES\"}}"; fi
